aspect: Databases copy, they do not verify
description: The error propagates from the first record into every downstream system, each of which treats the others as corroboration.
energy_note: One typo, confirmed by four systems.

aspect: You are presumed to be the unreliable party
description: The person asserting the record is wrong is, by default, the one whose account is doubted. Institutions trust their own data over a person standing in front of them.
energy_note: Your word against a field in a database.

aspect: Correction requires the original, which may not exist
description: Fixing it means producing the authoritative source document - from an archive that may have been destroyed, in a jurisdiction that may not answer.
energy_note: Fix it by producing a document from a building that's gone.

aspect: EXAMPLE - punished for a relative's overstay
description: In seven petitions filed for Palestinian Christians in Gaza denied permits to visit holy sites and family, the ground cited in all seven cases was 'overstay' - meaning the applicant had a relative who at some point overstayed a permit.
energy_note: Seven refusals, seven relatives, no act by the applicant.
